structured.approach: This is attempt 4. The only refusal point was G1: the receipt hash I quoted in the output's opening paragraph does not appear in any source the judge can see. I removed the hash and kept only the input's commit, b0fd4d2, which appears in record:brief. I rewrote task.secrets_scope.md in full; everything else is unchanged from attempt 3 and is grounded only on feat.tasks, tool:repo-access (the permission-table view; org.permission_table is restricted and used by reference only) and record:brief. The full rewrite also removed a stray '[Tool result] ...' line that had again been appended to the end of the draft on disk. No connectors were needed.

claims.text: The input feat.tasks comes from hobasa-design-agent at commit b0fd4d2.
The Data Science lane's tasks for FEAT-ZD-48600 are TSK-03 (STORY-03) and TSK-04 (STORY-04), both in ap_forecast.
The permission table's tool registry says no secrets are required or granted for the ap_forecast repository.
TSK-03 vendor_risk is rule-based, with no LLM, no network and no models.json read, and risk.py imports only predict_delay_days, so it needs no secret.

TSK-04 only appends the risk level to the prompt. Provider, model and max_tokens keep coming from config or load_config(), models.json does not change, and nothing new calls the function with risk, so it needs no new secret.
Sending the risk label to acme-llm waits on Architect confirmation (TQ-8), which gates release, not coding.
The repositories use feature/<story>, dev (integration) and main (released) branches. For each of these and for CI, the required and granted secrets are both empty, so no access request was raised.
The planned tests need no live provider: test_vendor_risk_no_llm patches ap_forecast.explain.load_config to fail, and the TSK-04 tests check the prompt text.

open_questions: SSQ-1 (non-blocking): Which component sends the build_explanation_request payload to acme-llm, and who owns its credential? It is outside the scope of TSK-03 and TSK-04. If ap_forecast ever calls the provider directly, DS-02 must be re-entered.

Non-blocking, for the spine owner: G2 refused file:ap_forecast/... citations in earlier attempts even though those files were read with Read in the same attempt. Is this a checker defect? Also, a '[Tool result] ...' line keeps being appended to the output draft on disk between attempts; please check where it comes from.
structured.summary: DS-02 attempt 4 is complete. I removed the unsupported receipt hash that caused the G1 refusal and rewrote task.secrets_scope.md in full. The ap_forecast tasks (TSK-03 and TSK-04) need no secrets in CI, feature, dev or main, and the permission table grants none, so required and granted access are both empty. No access request was needed. The output lists names only and has one non-blocking question (SSQ-1).
